：震惊的苏梅！（：震惊的苏梅！（第22页）多少是假的，还不好说。极阴之体纯元还在的话，那就是保护膜还有。不过没关系，反正他也没打算让师父去冒险。如果是真的，这么危险的事情，当徒弟的肯定要迎难而上。为师傅挡灾。他现在要和苏梅进行谈判。深夜，林枫让人把苏梅单独请到了自己的洞府。苏梅来的时候，换了一身素雅的月白色长裙，少了几分白日里的清冷，多了几分柔和。但她那双眼睛依旧明亮而精明，一进门就直直地看向林枫，眼神也有些警惕，似乎在猜测他深夜单独相请的用意。毕竟当初林枫可是公然说过，对她更感兴趣。“少宗主深夜相召，不知有何要事？”苏梅落座后，开门见山地问道。林枫也不兜圈子，给她斟了一杯灵茶，直接说道：“苏宫主，白日里和仙儿的婚事，我应下了。但有些话，我得提前跟你说明白。”苏梅端起茶杯，指尖在杯沿上轻轻摩挲着，等待他的下文。“我既然决定与仙儿成婚，那日后玉兰宫便是我林枫的盟友。我这个人你是知道的，对自己人从来不会亏待。但同样的，我也希望你能帮我一个忙。”林枫的目光认真而坦诚。苏梅放下茶杯，微微颔首：“少宗主请讲。”“不瞒你说，我日后要前往南华郡，此行凶险难测，不便携带家眷。我身边还有几位道侣，若将她们留在苍玄宗，我也放心不下。所以我想把她们托付给你，让她们在玉兰宫暂住一段时间。你帮我护她们周全，保她们平安。”苏梅听了，眼中闪过一丝了然，随即毫不犹豫地点头：“此事不难。玉兰宫本就只有女弟子，几位姑娘住进来倒也便宜。少宗主放心，只要有我苏梅在一日，便绝不会让人欺负了她们。”林枫见她答应得这么爽快，微微笑了笑。他顿了顿，忽然压低声音，语气变得郑重起来：“苏宫主，不过我这人向来生性多疑，只相信自己人。”来了！！！苏梅神色微微紧张，她明白林枫接下来不会说什么好话。因此并未搭话，而是等待林枫的下文。林枫看着苏梅紧张的样子，嘿嘿一笑。“与我而言，只有我的女人才算自己人”苏梅急忙道：“这绝对不行，你是仙儿的道侣，绝对不行”林枫笑道：“苏宫主也别着急拒绝，不如先听一听我的条件”闻言，苏梅：“什么条件也不可能答应”“哦是吗？你若能成为我的女人，作为回报，我可以向你承诺一件事，帮你突破元婴”这句话落在苏梅耳中，不啻于一声惊雷。她端着茶杯的手猛地一颤，杯中的茶水差点洒出来。她抬起头，难以置信地望着林枫，那双平日里波澜不惊的眼睛，此刻写满了震惊。“这怎么可能？”随即，苏梅摇摇头道：“你如何帮我”见状，林枫身上突然多了一件黑色袍子。苏梅目瞪口呆的望着林枫，语气有些颤抖道：“是是你？”

Chapter 672 Shocked Su Mei (page 1)
:Shocked Su Mei! (: Shocked Su Mei! (Page 22) It’s hard to say how much is fake. If the pure essence of the extremely yin body is still there, it means that the protective film is still there. But it doesn’t matter, he didn’t intend to let the master take the risk anyway. If it is true, and such a dangerous thing, the apprentice must face the difficulties and protect the master from disaster. He now wants to negotiate with Su Mei. Late at night, Lin Feng asked Su Mei to be alone in his cave. When Su Mei came, she changed into an elegant moon-white dress, which was a little less cold in the daytime and a little more soft. However, her eyes were still bright and shrewd. She looked straight at Lin Feng as soon as she entered the door, and her eyes were a little wary, as if she was guessing the purpose of his invitation alone late at night. After all, Lin Feng had openly said that he was more interested in her late at night. "What's the important matter?" Su Meiluo said. After sitting down, he asked straight to the point. Lin Feng didn't mince words, and poured her a cup of spiritual tea, and said directly: "Palace Master Su, I agree to marry Xian'er during the day. But there are some things I have to explain to you in advance." Su Mei picked up the tea cup and gently rubbed the edge of the cup with her fingertips, waiting for his words. "Since I have decided to marry Xian'er, Magnolia Palace will be my Lin Feng's ally in the future. You know me. I will never treat my own people badly. But at the same time, I also hope that you can do me a favor. Su Mei put down the tea cup and nodded slightly: "To tell you the truth, I will go to Nanhua County in the future, and it will be dangerous and unpredictable, and I will not be able to bring my family with me. I will not worry about leaving them in Cangxuan Sect." Here, let them stay in the Magnolia Palace for a while. Please help me protect them and keep them safe." After hearing this, Su Mei's eyes flashed with understanding, and she nodded without hesitation: "It's not difficult for the Magnolia Palace to have only female disciples. It's cheap for a few girls to live there. Don't worry, as long as I, Su Mei, are here, no one will bully them." Lin Feng saw her agreeing so readily. He smiled. He paused and suddenly lowered his voice, and his tone became serious: "Palace Master Su, I have always been suspicious and only trust my own people." Come on! Su Mei looked slightly nervous, so she didn't say anything, but waited for Lin Feng's nervous look, "For me, only my woman is my wife. "My friend" Su Mei hurriedly said: "This is absolutely not possible. You are Xian'er's Taoist companion. This is absolutely not possible." Lin Feng said with a smile: "Palace Master Su, don't be in a hurry to refuse. Why don't you listen to my conditions first?" Hearing this, Su Mei said: "I can't agree to any conditions." "Oh, really? If you can become my woman, in return, I can promise you one thing, to help you break through the Nascent Soul." This sentence fell in Su Mei's ears, which was like a thunder. . Her hand holding the tea cup trembled, and the tea in the cup almost spilled. She raised her head and looked at Lin Feng in disbelief, her usually calm eyes filled with shock. "How is this possible?" Then Su Mei shook her head and said, "How can you help me?" Seeing this, Su Mei looked at Lin Feng in shock, and said in a trembling voice: "Is it you?"
